craft_notes: Sthāyin: ordered-course (world as syllabus). Rows: row 2 (gross→subtle→supreme→dissolves). Close: at end (ante — the course has terminus). Rejected: 'cosmology explained' — killed: course kept as walkable; splitting the standing-list — killed: three stages one line.

lines: World-course and rest formed, in order, all:
gross-subtle-supreme standing — till mind dissolves at end.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhuvanādhvādirūpeṇa cintayet kramaśo 'khilam | sthūlasūkṣmaparasthityā yāvad ante manolayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is contemplated in order? → The ordered world-course runs to the end where mind dissolves.
c1_essence: Ordered world-course run: mind dissolves at its end.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
